notes:
Lead type: inbound self-serve. Small engineering org (50-180 engs + CS). Primary product: chat-first customer support widget embedded on sites.

Primary pain: latency. Live users in EU complaining — measured median latency ~620ms for typical responses (20-80 tokens), p95 ~1.3s; occasional requests hit client-side timeout (30s) when prompt context is large (~3–5k tokens). Customer target: median <300ms for short replies, p95 <600ms. Cost sensitivity: moderate — wants to keep hosted usage under $5k/month initially.

Tech stack: Node backend (express) + Redis for session state, using Redwood Node SDK via hosted_api. Streaming enabled for UI but they rely on full-response fallback for some flows. Currently default region set to us-west1; many users are EU — leads to higher RTT. They tried us-east1 during call and saw better for NA but EU still slow.

Customer asks / requests: "Can you give specific tuning steps? Where do we change timeouts and recommended values? Which region should we pick for a NA-first product with active EU users? How to trim prompts safely? Any quick quantization/model recommendations for lower latency?"

Observed behaviors and quick SE notes: - Long system messages + full transcript sent every request increases token counts and amplifies latency. Recommend moving system content to per-session cached prefix or use KV cache. - Suggest shorter system templates + dynamic summaries for history (condense previous turns). - SDK/client timeout: client had 30s; recommend app-level timeout ~60s for long-run jobs but adjust request-level to 10s for typical chat to surface failures quickly and rely on streaming. - Region guidance: set primary region to us-east1 for NA majority; enable EU routing for EU users or use Redwood routing policy -> route by user geo to closest region; fall back to lighter-weight model variant for cross-region failover. - Batching: for high-concurrency support bursts, enable adaptive batching in Optimize and set max batch latency to 10ms to reduce per-token cost without hurting latency. - Prompt length: aim for <1024 tokens end-to-end for real-time chat; for retrieval augmented flows, truncate/document summary strategy.

Quotes from customer: "We love the SDK — but our EU customers are complaining about choppy replies. If we can't get median down, we'll have to explore alternatives. Need concrete checklist."

Next immediate deliverables: SE to run a perf checklist (network traceroutes + synthetic pings from EU), share a one-page prompt trimming checklist, recommended timeout snippets for Node SDK, and a region-routing config example. Schedule: SE deep-dive booked for 2026-03-12.
